timeline.title: The BEACNpool GitHub account is created
BEACN registers as a stake pool
timeline.html: One operator, bare metal, Chicago. Active from epoch 595 at 0% margin.

timeline.title: BEACN comes alive on X
timeline.html: The @BEACNpool account, opened in 2023 but silent until now, starts telling the story.

timeline.title: Fees cut to the floor, pledge raised
timeline.html: The fixed fee drops from 340 to 170 ADA, the protocol minimum, and pledge rises from 500 to 15,000 ADA, effective epoch 603.

timeline.title: The Bible, on chain
timeline.html: The Library's first great work: 237 pages and a manifest, minted as 238 NFTs the day after a first manifest on New Year's Day.

timeline.title: Ledger Scrolls goes public
timeline.html: An open reader that rebuilds data straight from Cardano. Source

timeline.title: Cardano's Constitution, twice
timeline.html: The epoch 541 and epoch 608 editions, 20 NFTs in all.

timeline.title: FIRST WORDS: BEACN's first scroll
timeline.html: A manifest and three pages, minted from the pool owner's wallet.

timeline.title: The first video
timeline.html: 175 pages and a manifest, minted over two days.

timeline.title: The first BEACN DRep registers
timeline.html: Nine votes through 29 April; deregistered 14 May with its deposit returned.

timeline.title: The Light Was Always For You
timeline.html: A picture stored across two on-chain metadata pages.

timeline.title: The BEACN DRep system opens as four public repositories
timeline.html: Doctrine, admitted inputs, deterministic execution and public transparency, kept strictly apart.

timeline.title: ABCDE is published
timeline.html: Every founder coin, followed to today. Explorer

timeline.title: BEACN Leaks and the Declaration of Authorship
timeline.html: The publisher channel's first issues, minted as scrolls.

timeline.title: The automated BEACN DRep registers
timeline.html: Fifty votes through 31 August (34 No, 8 Yes, 8 Abstain), each published with its reasoning. Voting archive

timeline.title: The SecondFi incident audit is published
timeline.html: Audit package

timeline.title: The Library becomes an NFT
timeline.html: The registry of every scroll moves on chain; version 7 has been the head since 12 July.

timeline.title: Ledger Chess, playable from a scroll
timeline.html: Play

timeline.title: The brand is minted
timeline.html: BEACN Sigil, Epoch Clock and Neon Sign; business cards, Registry Mark and Brand Seal followed within two days.

timeline.title: LAN Games is released
timeline.html: Source

timeline.title: oligarCH begins
timeline.html: BURN YOU TO THE GROUND is minted; all eight timed pieces exist by the next day, and the maker opens after them. Series

timeline.title: BEACN vs grokbot
timeline.html: Two agents, identical ADA, one encrypted channel between them. The match closed 12 September. Final scorecard

timeline.title: BMKR and the on-chain originals
timeline.html: The Light We Leave, The Impossible Dawn, Chain Pressure, the Creation Engine and two pixel films.

timeline.title: NFT Studio launches
timeline.html: Six on-chain games, STARFALL, AFTERLIGHT, NINEFOLD and three Harmonic Machines are minted the same day. Studio

timeline.title: Five Small Worlds and Draw a Sound
timeline.html: Interactive science studies, a day after Days Without Cardano Drama.

timeline.title: The Last Watch
timeline.html: BEACN's farewell NFT is minted, ATM RUNNER is minted from a phone, and the pool's retirement certificate is filed.

timeline.title: The DRep deregisters
timeline.html: Its record stays public.

timeline.title: The warehouse goes dark
timeline.html: ABCDE is powered off; its data, the films and this page move to GitHub.

timeline.title: Retirement takes effect
timeline.html: Epoch 656, 21:44:51 UTC. The light goes out; the work stays.
